What We Design

Eight connected parts shape the guest experience and the way your team works.

01

Dining Room Layout

Tables, booths and circulation planned around comfort, capacity and smooth service.

02

Kitchen & Back-of-House Planning

Prep, cooking, storage and staff routes arranged around the operating model.

03

Bar & Beverage Counter

A practical focal point with clear service flow, storage and guest seating.

04

Lighting & Ambience

Layered light creates the right mood while keeping tables and routes clear.

05

Furniture Selection

Tables, chairs and booths chosen for comfort, durability and the room's scale.

06

Entrance & Waiting Area

The first impression, host point and guest queue are planned as one arrival.

07

Outdoor & Rooftop Seating

Weather, comfort, lighting and service access shape usable open-air dining.

08

Brand Theming & Décor

Materials, colour and details express the cuisine without feeling forced.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the restaurant from brief to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss the cuisine, guests, cover target, service style, budget and opening plan.

02

Site Measurement

We record the floor, access, services, kitchen needs and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Dining, bar, kitchen and guest movement are tested as one working plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, tables, seating, lighting and décor are coordinated.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Approved 3D views and drawings prepare the restaurant for pricing and build.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. Your fixed quote follows the survey, once the cover count, kitchen scope and 3D package are clear.
